capabilities.name: Canonical App Persistence (SupabaseStore adapter)
capabilities.evidence: P1 #5. 19 passing unit tests (tests/supabase-store.test.js) against a hand-written fake Supabase query-builder client — never exercised against a live Supabase project or the real @supabase/supabase-js. Handles projects/tracks; throws UnsupportedOperationError (loud, not silent) for the 5 tables the live schema doesn't support (assets, processing_jobs, ownership_records, rights, audit_log). Opt-in only via persistence/index.js's factory (type: 'supabase'); local JSON/memory remains the default per CLAUDE.md's local-first architecture decision. Live-validation gate attempted 2026-08-13 and BLOCKED (no network path from the working session to the configured local Supabase instance at 127.0.0.1:54321; see docs/SUPABASE_LIVE_CONTRACT_REPORT.md). That same static comparison pass found a concrete write-path defect the mocked tests could not catch: repository.createProject() never sets rezonate_projects.user_id, a NOT NULL foreign key — every Supabase-mode project write would fail with a not_null_violation. tracks is otherwise column-compatible.
capabilities.verified_by: P1 remediation session (mocked client only) + live-validation gate session (static schema comparison only, live DB unreachable)
capabilities.notes: Do not mark VERIFIED or PRODUCTION until run against a real Supabase project AND the user_id write-path defect is fixed. Cutting the canonical app over from local to this adapter by default is P1 #9/#10, deliberately deferred — see docs/REZONATE_CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md.
